snippet.title: Heavy Wake - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4235660/Heavy_Wake/


Explore a cursed island, recruit strange survivors, and battle through tactical card encounters in this short dark-fantasy deckbuilding RPG. Each companion adds unique cards and passive abilities that reshape your deck. Guide Fyodor on a desperate search for a cure for his dying tribe.
